Daniel took Sway AI from $0 to $2M ARR in 6 months, and he had paying customers before he wrote a single line of code. Now he's the Head of Product at Cal AI, the calorie-tracking app that just got acquired by MyFitnessPal.

In this episode, Daniel walks through the exact playbook he used at Sway and now runs at Cal AI: the pre-launch Instagram distribution that got strangers paying $15 before there was even an app, the TikTok slideshow system that batches a month of content in two hours, the paywal
l structure that defaults to annual to fuel growth, and the framework he uses to pick the next novel app idea.

He also shares what he learned at Snap, Robinhood, and Meta about design taste, why Cal AI's three core screens are built specifically for influencers to demo, and the influencer-equity strategy for shipping multiple apps at once.
